01 / Core Capabilities

Runtime visibility without the runtime tax.

Pinpoint connects runtime signals to the code responsible for them.

03 / CI Regression Gate

Block N+1s before they merge.

Pinpoint doubles as a regression gate for your pull requests. Run your suite, then let pinpoint:check fail the build when a PR introduces an N+1 or blows a query budget — with the exact SQL and file:line in the output.

From tests to merge gate, one command

$ php artisan pinpoint:check --fail-on-n1 --max-queries=20
--fail-on-n1
Fail when any request repeats the same SQL 3+ times — Eloquent lazy loads included.
--max-queries=20
Fail when any request exceeds your query budget.
--max-duration-ms=250
Fail when a request exceeds your latency SLA.
--since=30m
Only inspect the current test run, so old samples never false-fail a PR.
--json
Structured output for PR-bot automation.

Exits 0 on pass, 1 on fail. Callers are captured in testing/local — run tests with APP_ENV=testing so the report pinpoints the exact file:line.

.github/workflows/tests.yml 
name: Performance Gate
on: [pull_request]

jobs:
  gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
      - name: Run test suite
        run: php artisan test
        env:
          APP_ENV: testing
      - name: Enforce Pinpoint gate
        run: php artisan pinpoint:check --fail-on-n1 --max-queries=20

FAIL api.orders.index (exit 1)

at app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php:84

Where Pinpoint differs

Built around the Laravel runtime.

Pinpoint is for developers who want actionable runtime diagnostics without a heavyweight observability stack.

04 / Documentation

Start profiling in minutes.

Three commands from zero to actionable latency insight.

01

Install as a dev dependency

$ composer require asimali/pinpoint --dev
02

Publish & run migrations

$ php artisan vendor:publish --tag="pinpoint-migrations" && php artisan migrate
03

Generate your first latency report

$ php artisan pinpoint:report

Pinpoint v1.0.0 Stable

Pinpoint is a local-first runtime request profiler and automated Eloquent N+1 detection engine for Laravel applications. Built to catch bottlenecks and database duplicate queries at runtime before they impact production users.
